title: dev mode bypasses credential check without warning on authenticated sessions
description: lifecycle.rs: is_dev_mode() returns true when required=false AND users=[] AND credential_file=None. A production server misconfigured with required=false and no users configured accepts any password. The auth bypass is silent — no warn\!() at auth-time, no log entry indicating dev mode is active. An operator who sets required=false thinking it means 'auth is optional' but forgets to add users will be wide-open. Should emit a prominent tracing::warn at startup (or at auth time) when dev mode is active.
